stories.title: Garden waste collections delayed to evening across Flintshire today
stories.summary: Flintshire households due a brown bin collection today will have their garden waste collected this evening instead of during the day. The change follows a rise in recycling volumes across the county after recent hot weather. Garden waste crews and vehicles have been moved temporarily to help clear recycling collections during daytime hours. Flintshire County

stories.title: Flintshire council committee set to consider Pentre Moch name change for Northop Hall
stories.summary: A Flintshire village could soon adopt the historical Welsh name Pentre Moch – or Pig Holding. The request to formally move Pentre Moch as the formal Welsh name for Northop Hall will be considered by Flintshire County Council’s Corporate Resources Overview and Scrutiny Committee on Thursday. It will then make recommendations to the council’s Cabinet

stories.title: Flintshire forecast to hit 30C as third heatwave of the year builds
stories.summary: Flintshire is forecast to hit 30C this week, as the third heatwave of the year builds across the UK. The latest forecast for Hawarden shows temperatures climbing from 24C on Monday to a peak of 30C on Friday, before easing back to 27C over the weekend. stories.title: North Wales force’s handling of rural crime and emergency calls examined by PCC
stories.summary: North Wales Police’s handling of rural crime and how quickly officers respond to emergency calls faced scrutiny at the force’s latest Strategic Executive Board meeting. Police and Crime Commissioner Andy Dunbobbin held the session with Chief Constable Amanda Blakeman KPM and other senior officers. The board reviewed force performance across finance, resourcing, risk, HMICFRS inspections

stories.title: Deeside hair technician Jackie Holland wins Unsung Hero award
stories.summary: Coleg Cambria is celebrating national recognition after staff and campuses were honoured at two of the hair and beauty industry’s leading awards programmes. Hair technician Jackie Holland won the Unsung Hero Award at the prestigious Concept Hair Recognition Awards, while Julie Guzzo, Curriculum Director of Technical Studies, received the coveted Services to the Industry Award
